prompts.arms: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game sprite attachment atlas, exactly 3 columns and 6 rows = 18 separate illustrated gun-with-arms sprites. Input reference 1 (arms.png) is the exact existing game arm/hand visual style and outfit row order; references 2,3,4 are three original weapon designs to preserve faithfully, reference 5 shows Last Watch armor palette context. Draw only two sleeves, gloved cat paws visibly and naturally gripping a gun, and that entire gun, NO head/body/legs. Every sprite is horizontal side profile aimed directly right. Shoulder sleeve at left, barrel muzzle at right. Compact bent elbows, near paw grips trigger/handle and far paw supports fore-end, like reference 1. Rich hand-painted cartoon game illustration, dark ink contours and chunky readable shape, same scale/detail as existing arms. Columns repeat same weapons across all 6 rows: LEFT Lanternline: long walnut precision rifle, teal receiver, brass scope with small warm amber lantern lens, retain slender barrel; MIDDLE Breachmaker: short heavy double barrel steel shotgun, reddish walnut, chunky brass muzzle collar, small red strap, no scope; RIGHT Signalstorm: compact blue-gray brass carbine, short walnut stock, cyan radio coil and small aerial, curved magazine. Row1 orange fur paws with olive green fatigues sleeves/brown fingerless gloves. Row2 orange fur with dark teal ranger sleeves/navy fingerless gloves. Row3 orange fur with navy blue brass-edged armored sleeves/navy fingerless gloves, Last Watch compatible. Row4 cream white fur paws with olive sleeves/brown gloves. Row5 cream white fur with dark teal ranger sleeves/navy gloves. Row6 cream white fur with navy brass-edged armor sleeves/navy gloves. Keep all 18 guns and both arms complete, fully isolated inside equal size cells, all muzzle heights aligned within each row; wide clear transparent gutters. Crisp original illustrated hands wrapped around real grips, not circles. No floating weapons. No human skin. No labels, lettering, cell borders, watermark or background. Actual RGBA transparency. Prefer a square canvas with all 18 well-separated sprites, consistent shoulder pivot about 10 percent from each cell left and near gun bore centerline.

Reference2 is Blackglass Pathfinder armor: CHANGE ONLY sleeves/gloves to match this charcoal leather armor with subtle violet crystal shoulder trim and a silver cuff seam, dark charcoal fingerless gloves; exposed cat paws orange fur on entire top row and cream white fur on entire bottom row. Columns left to right Lanternline scope lantern rifle, Breachmaker double-barrel shotgun, Signalstorm radio coil carbine. Recreate exactly these three arm/gun assemblies with custom Blackglass sleeves in two skin colors. No teal cloth, no olive cloth, no navy/gold plate. No body/head/legs, just sleeves plus both gripping paws and complete guns. Broad rounded sleeved shoulder root at far left suitable for an opaque pivot; trigger paw wraps around gun handle, support paw under fore-end. Horizontal right-facing guns, wide gutters.
